Reads ZUGFeRD / Factur-X and XRechnung e-invoices (XML or PDF with embedded XML) for .NET; profiles: XRechnung, EN 16931, Extended and more; syntax: CII and UBL; exposes all invoice fields as a view model and renders a readable PDF view. Free license.
Entity Framework Core integration for Riddersholm.Money: complex-type mapping, value converters and comparers, and precision helpers that stop decimal amounts being silently truncated.

A modern, immutable Money value object for .NET with complete ISO 4217 currency support, exact decimal arithmetic, sum-preserving allocation, allocation-free formatting and parsing, System.Text.Json support, and full trimming/NativeAOT compatibility.

Roslyn incremental source generator that turns an ISO 4217 currency definition file into strongly typed Currency members. Reference this package to define your own currencies (crypto, in-game, historic) with no reflection and no runtime registry.
